title: Exploring Gender Bias Beyond Occupational Titles

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the cloze probability of gendered pronouns given specific contexts (occupations, action verbs, object nouns) using the proposed ClozeGender Score (CGS), and evaluating the associations using Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) and KL divergence. It also includes evaluating gender stereotypes in English and Japanese datasets.

Evaluating the association between occupations and social/ethnic groups (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) by measuring cloze probability updates on sentences using gender-neutral pronouns when introducing racial and social group terms.
